facts: Plan Kecil data plans: Plan Kecil RM15 a month with 5GB, Plan Sederhana RM35 a month with 20GB, Plan Besar RM50 a month with unlimited data.
Any plan can be changed once a month at no charge from the account page on example.test.
Plan Kecil sells SIM cards: each of the three data plans is a SIM card plan, and the SIM card is the plan. There are no other products.
Customers sign up for a plan on the sign-up page on example.test.
